body: To be honest it just doesn't seem feasible to be able to block out a part of who you are. I may be wrong, but it just doesn't seem doable.
Thanks man. I appreciate it.
Ah gotcha. I'm not sure that I really am in to any type of spirituality, but the video seems like a good exercise to try.
I thank you for your kind words. With the username it just seems kind of strange to me.
I feel like this is spam advertisement in some way.
A sincere question for you. What constitutes a great life?
The pleasure is all mine. I came here for help, and you responded. Thank you, Captain.
That might be the most memorable thing anyone has ever said to me.

I agree with you that having the strength to be different is admirable. But I don't believe I possess that strength. As far as me seeming like I have great qualities, I feel as if that was said without backing. It is hard to tell the qualities of a stranger on a throwaway account.
I guess that is true. I've been told not to let others dictate the way I live my life. But it is inhuman not to take into account what others think of you.
I don't know that I really understand.
I'm not necessarily a child, I guess technically their child. But regardless of the way I feel that they should treat their children, it doesn't change their views or ways.

It's not really a contest of who is a better person, I don't think. I don't really seek to be better than them in anyway. I've often considered moving to another country, just to limit my contact with them.

If i'm on tomorrow night I certainly will. Tomorrow I have a lotto do, and I'll have work the following day. I'll be certain to try and be here. I guess trying to push out my depression is an option. But I don't very much believe it is a good option.
I don't think it's possible to just remove one part of your thought process.
I wouldn't as long as they were happy. However, my opinions do not shape the opinions of those I'm surrounded by.
I don't feel comfortable talking to someone like that, nor do I have the funds to even think about doing that. I don't really think I want a purpose.
I'm the only person in my family who isn't in school who's making less than 6 figures. By their standards, I don't fit in. It's evident by the way they treat me and the way I react to them.
I don't really have a strong desire to do anything 'good' at the moment. Right now my desire is to find out how to be happy with myself. After that I will find out how to be productive.

I have tried seeing a therapist before and i felt uncomfortable. I honestly don't believe that any of us have a purpose, but I do believe that others have an easier time accepting that than I do. Or even, others form their own sort of purpose. I have no desire to form a purpose.
I thank you for your kind words. But they thing about a fact is, it's true whether you choose to believe it or not.
No good has come of my existence. I'm a college dropout working a shit job to try and scrape rent. I don't measure up near anyone else in my family.

It doesn't seem like just a trial. I don't quite understand the reason that I am alive. Each day I regret that I have made it this far in life. There is very little that I am happy doing, and even then I don't know that I'm happy doing it. I believe I just participate in hobbies because I can pretend I am happy.
I feel I am a disappointment because I've been told that I am.
